findings.citation: It also orders the spares: they go into `export_fabrication` (`out/sendcutsend_order.csv`, `part` column) and the manufacturability check.
findings.description: The order CSV is checked for the _L spares. No probe checks that the spares reach the manufacturability check, or that build logs the mesh rows and problems. The impact is minor: the spares are large gears that would never trip the size limit anyway.

findings.citation: Report a binding value as null.
findings.description: The report verifier normalizes both a reported null and a reported numeric 0 to 0 before comparison, so it does not enforce null for binding report values.

findings.citation: `build.py`: run the mesh analysis in both `--check` and full builds, and log its rows and problems.
findings.description: The checks exercise mesh analysis in both modes, but they never inspect logging, so rows and problem messages need not be logged.

findings.citation: It also orders the spares: they go into `export_fabrication` (`out/sendcutsend_order.csv`, `part` column) and the manufacturability check.
findings.description: `build: the loose spares are ordered with the parts` verifies CSV inclusion, but no check verifies that the spares are passed through manufacturability.

findings.citation: `main()` returns nonzero if there's any interference or mesh problem, and 0 otherwise.
findings.description: Failure variants are run only with `--check`; no check verifies a nonzero return from a full build containing an interference or mesh problem.

findings.citation: Each spare is kind `"scs"` with the same teeth, thinning `GEAR_BACKLASH_LOOSE` (thinner than the nominal gear), and an outline from `gears.gear_polygon` at its default resolution with that thinning.
findings.description: The spare-shape check verifies names, kind, teeth, thinning, outline, and assembly exclusion, but not that each spare has quantity one as required by the preceding phrase `one spare of every laser-cut gear`.

findings.citation: `report() -> list[dict]`: one row per pair, with at least `pair` (its name), `centre_mm`, `theoretical_mm`, `backlash_mm` (nominal), `backlash_fat_mm` (nominal parts cut `LASER_FAT` fat) and `backlash_loose_fat_mm` (laser gears built with `GEAR_BACKLASH_LOOSE`, cut `LASER_FAT` fat).
findings.description: The report verifier indexes rows by pair name and checks missing required pairs, but does not reject extra rows or duplicate rows, so the one-row-per-pair requirement is not enforced.
The verifier checks numeric outputs and operates under a timeout, but has no check that the implementation is closed-form rather than a sufficiently fast sweep or lookup-based implementation.
